name: Wood Pulp
summary: At Bael Modan, Wood Pulp helps the dwarves prepare their blasting charges. The dwarven personnel stationed in the southern Barrens carry it as an absorbent base for stabilizing liquid explosives.

sections.title: A Volatile Recipe
sections.body: At Bael Modan, Ironforge dwarves use earth-moving equipment and chemical explosives to tear into ancestral tauren hunting grounds. Liquid nitroglycerin is unstable on its own, so dwarven engineers soak it into porous wood pulp with sodium nitrate to make stable charges for excavation and combat. Riflemen, soldiers, and officers carry bundles for sapping and field munitions.

sections.title: Turned Against the Keep
sections.body: After Prospector Khazgorm fell, Gann Stonespire recovered the dwarves' blasting schematics. The displaced tauren warrior uses those practices against the invaders encroaching on his tribe's lands. From the Bael'dun garrison, Gann reclaims wood pulp, nitroglycerin, and nitrates to make a charge intended to destroy the dwarves' flying machine at Bael Modan.

faq.q: What is wood pulp used for in Bael Modan?
aliases: why do dwarves have wood pulp
faq.answer: At Bael Modan, dwarven engineers use wood pulp as an absorbent base for munitions. They soak unstable liquid nitroglycerin into it, making demolition charges safer for sappers to carry and handle.

faq.q: Who carries wood pulp in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Dwarven forces stationed at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens carry wood pulp. They include Bael'dun soldiers, riflemen, officers, and their commanding lord, Cyrik Blackforge.

faq.q: Why does Gann Stonespire need this wood pulp?
faq.answer: Gann Stonespire uses wood pulp to turn the dwarves' destructive methods against them. Following their demolition schematics, he combines it with recovered nitroglycerin and sodium nitrate to make a charge meant to destroy the dwarves' flying machine at Bael Modan.

faq.q: Does wood pulp explode by itself?
faq.answer: No. Raw wood pulp is shredded wood fiber; it becomes dangerous only when combined with volatile chemicals such as nitroglycerin and an oxidizer such as sodium nitrate.

angles.text: Engineers know wood pulp can absorb nitroglycerin and a nitrate oxidizer, stabilizing the volatile liquid in durable dynamite.
As a tauren of the Stonespire tribe, you see the invaders' munitions turned against Bael Modan as justice for the destruction of your ancestral home.
